## Screenshot explanations
Figures 1–3 demonstrate the user entry points and role-aware session. Figures 4–8 demonstrate the Organiser workflow from event setup through results publication. Figures 9–10 demonstrate Participant event and results views. Figures 11–12 show that banner uploads pass through the API to Azure Blob Storage and appear in MVC. Figure 13 demonstrates containerisation and Figure 14 demonstrates automated build/test validation.
